title: Mouth to Mouth
notes: Extended disco workouts combine insistent synthesizers, live players and Cynthia Johnson’s commanding soprano.

title: Pucker Up
notes: Disco-funk continues with Moroder-like synths, R&B vocals and one jazz-tinged extended jam.

title: Designer Music
notes: More varied post-disco songs, string arrangements and synth-led textures precede Johnson’s departure.
Margie Cox replaces Cynthia Johnson amid programmed funk grooves, guitars and dancefloor songwriting.
